sub.account: What Retail owes the ERP, from the shop's own ledger. An entry is never changed or deleted: a mistake is put right by a new entry.

bk.v5: The books start when this store switches to ERP contract v6. Until then nothing is written here.
bk.noLink: This store has no ERP connection of its own yet. The books open with its first ERP pull.

hold.on: On hold: the ERP takes no new orders
hold.holdsOn: A hold starts on {date} if no payment comes
hold.noPay: No payment recorded by the ERP yet

chain.broken: The ledger was changed outside the shop at entry {seq}. Tell the developer at once.

bk.opening: Opening balance at the switch: {amount} from {date}

empty.entriesSub: The first entry comes when an order's parcel leaves (the ERP's bill).
empty.pipelineSub: Every billed piece is delivered, approved or declined.

pay.done: Saved. Nothing was sent to the ERP and no money moved.
pay.warn: This only writes down a payment you already made to the ERP. It sends no money and nothing to the ERP.
pay.readOnly: Only Accounts or the owner can record a payment to the ERP.
pay.matched: Matched with the ERP's payment of {date}
pay.shopOnly: The ERP has not recorded it yet
pay.erpOnly: Payments the ERP recorded that are not recorded here

err.NOT_FOUND: It is not there any more. Reload the page.
err.NOT_V6: The books start when this store switches to ERP contract v6.
err.NO_LINK: This store has no ERP connection of its own yet.
err.CONFLICT: This cannot be done to this record.
err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this.
err.default: That did not work. Try again.
